cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. With what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.
